findings.claim: With no extras passed, no original invariant is weakened
findings.evidence: Extras loop (lines 67-82) skipped => extras=[] and extra_pinned=[]; inputs.extend([]) is a no-op (line 87); undefined-delta refusal at lines 93-102 requires BOTH a.extra_unit truthy AND not removed AND not changed_bindings to extend, so with no extras any added/removed/changed delta raises 'Unexpected native import change' exactly as the original did. All pre-existing checks (BASE sha pin L23, host/rust receipt hash pins L25-30, originals input-hashes L33-34, prior-composite refusal L35, exactly-one-old-rust L36-37, unit source/object pins L39-43, fresh-dep must-be-in-pins L60-62, affected-inventory set equality L42) execute before any extra handling and are unaffected by extra args. Reference: native-1 receipt (original script) tolerated zero delta (added/removed/changed = []/[]/{}, 197 symbols) proving the original refusal behavior the no-extras path preserves.

findings.claim: --extend-undefined-baseline alone (no extras) weakens nothing
findings.evidence: Line 94 condition `a.extra_unit and a.extend_undefined_baseline and ...` is false without extras, falling to the unconditional raise at line 102.

findings.claim: Provider gate actually nm-verifies added symbols against pinned SDK libraries
findings.evidence: Lines 95-101 run llvm-nm -D --defined-only over every outputs/ps5-mod-bridge/native-host/build/sdk-v0.43/ps5-payload-sdk/target/lib/*.so; missing providers raise. run-1 command log: 34 sdknm-* commands all exit 0 with saved stdout; sdknm-libkernel.so.stdout contains sceKernelGetModuleInfo (T). Independently re-verified with pinned LLVM-21.1.8 llvm-nm: libkernel.so defines sceKernelGetModuleInfo as global text at 0x1218c.

findings.claim: linker_provided allow-list is minimal ({'_DYNAMIC'} only) and justified
findings.evidence: build_runtime.py:97. Verified no SDK target/lib/*.so exports _DYNAMIC (nm -D --defined-only across all libs => none), so without the exemption the gate would have rejected it; _DYNAMIC is the standard ELF dynamic-section symbol defined by the final PRX/ELF link (the TU references it via `extern "C" Elf64_Dyn _DYNAMIC[]`, live_module_os_ops_sce.cpp:60). Nothing else needed the exemption.

findings.claim: No __dl* or dlfcn symbols in the composed object's undefined set
findings.evidence: Pinned llvm-nm --extern-only --undefined-only over the 117,624,920-byte object: grep -Ec '^( _?_dl|dlfcn|dlopen|dlsym|dlclose)' = 0 matches. Broad case-insensitive sweep finds only sceKernelDlsym, a PS5 SDK module API already present in the pre-extension baseline (native-1) and exported by libkernel.so (verified) - not a libdl/dlfcn import.
